transcript: Hi everyone, just a quick project status update. The backend API is 80% complete. We're blocked on the payment integration because we're still waiting for credentials from the finance team. The frontend team has finished the dashboard but needs final design approval from marketing before we can ship. We're currently on track to hit the October 1st deadline if the blockers are resolved this week.
